title: pg_durable: Microsoft open sources in-database durable execution
summary: Microsoft has open-sourced pg_durable, a PostgreSQL extension that enables durable in-database execution where code can run within the database and survive server restarts or crashes, providing reliability guarantees for critical business operations.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of unreliable execution where database operations or business logic can be lost during system failures or restarts.
why_valuable: Enables developers to build fault-tolerant database applications where critical operations are guaranteed to complete or recover gracefully, eliminating data loss scenarios in production systems.
